claim: Texas rule (Cornell LII snapshot of 25 TAC 157.32; may predate 2026 changes) requires an EMT course to include at least 150 clock hours of classroom, lab, clinical and field instruction, with supervised experience in the emergency department and with a licensed EMS provider; no separate clinical hour count in this text.
quote: The course shall include a minimum of 150 clock hours of classroom, laboratory, clinical, and field instruction which shall include supervised experiences in the emergency department and with a licensed EMS provider
title: 25 TAC 157.32 (Cornell LII)

claim: DSHS march 2026 GETAC slide deck reportedly lists current EMT at 150 total hours and proposes 192 (144 classroom/lab + 48 clinical/field); read only via search snippet, not fetched.
quote: EMT Current – 150 hours total classroom, lab, and rotations
title: GETAC March 12 2026 (search snippet)

claim: RC Health Texas traditional page: 140 online didactic hours, 6-month completion, clinicals of 48 h EMS (>=6 patient transports) plus 24 h ED, at hospitals and municipal 911 agencies; no DFW site named.
quote: Students will complete 48 hours of EMS time with at least 6 patient transports, and 24 hours of Emergency Department time.
title: RC Health Texas Online EMT-Basic (Live Oak page)

claim: RC Health Dallas page states two skills practice days plus at least one NREMT skills testing day, and the same 48 h EMS/24 h ED clinical requirement.
quote: Each student will complete two skills practice days and at least one National Registry Skills Testing Day.
title: RC Health Dallas Online EMT-Basic Course

claim: RC Health hybrid/virtual page: four skills days (BLS day, two practice, one NREMT testing) and a smaller clinical load of 24 h EMS with at least 4 patient contacts.
quote: The student will complete 24 hours of EMS time with at least 4 patient contacts.
title: RC Health EMT Hybrid/Virtual Course

claim: RC Health Irving page describes clinicals only generically (no hospital or EMS agency named, no hours) and says tuition includes clinical rotation fees, background check, drug screen, badge and liability insurance.
quote: Complete hospital and ambulance clinical rotations for real-world experience.
title: RC Health EMS Academy Dallas/Irving

claim: RC Health Irving: online/hybrid year-round, traditional/weekend classes only 'periodically'; certification in as little as 4 months.
quote: Our Irving campus offers online and hybrid EMT courses year-round, with traditional and weekend classes offered periodically
title: RC Health EMS Academy Dallas/Irving

claim: Dallas EMT homepage: 150-hour program, online lectures, 3-day skills weekend, formats of 2, 4 and 14 weeks, all-inclusive tuition; clinical rotations and ambulance ride-alongs mentioned without hours or named sites.
quote: All tracks include the same 150-hour curriculum with a 3-day skills weekend.
title: Dallas EMT homepage

claim: Dallas EMT mentions DFW clinical rotations and ride-alongs only in marketing terms (no hours, sites, or scheduler stated).
quote: DFW clinical rotations and ambulance ride-alongs give you real-world exposure
title: Dallas EMT homepage

claim: Dallas College: EMT certificate requires 272 training hours covering hospital rotations, classroom, lab and ambulance internships; hospital rotations emphasise ED.
quote: The EMT certification program requires 272 training hours that consist of hospital rotations, classroom instruction, lab practice and internships​ in an ambulance.
title: Dallas College EMT Program

claim: Dallas College formats: in person, hybrid, evenings and weekdays, year-round; first-come first-served registration.
quote: In person, hybrid, evenings and weekdays.
title: Dallas College EMT Program

claim: Dallas College EMT estimated tuition $891 in-county (page lists $891-$4,158 across tiers); extra costs include uniform $22-$26, SurScan $15, drug screen $42, background check $45, fingerprinting about $50.
quote: Estimated tuition total: $891 for in-county residents
title: Dallas College EMT Program

claim: UT Dallas UEMR EMT class: student schedules own clinicals via app after lectures; three 12 h ED clinicals plus one 12 h fire department rotation; named hospitals and fire departments; Hybrid or Mon-Fri 8:30-4:30 Academy formats. (UT Dallas is not on the brief list; it also claims other programs' clinicals may be lower standard.)
quote: You will complete three 12 hour Emergency Department Clinicals and one 12-hour clinical rotation with a local fire department.
title: UT Dallas EMT Class FAQ

claim: UT Dallas names clinical partners THR Plano, THR Dallas, Methodist Dallas, Richardson, Mansfield, Charlton and internship fire departments.
quote: Our clinical partners include THR Plano, THR Dallas, Methodist Dallas, Methodist Richardson, Methodist Mansfield, and Methodist Charlton.
title: UT Dallas EMT Class FAQ

claim: TCC EMT is two courses, EMSP 1501 (lecture/lab) and EMSP 1160 clinical; clinical hours not found in fetched pages. Page lists $1,332 total tuition and fees in-county and notes students pay for meals and parking on clinical rotations.
title: TCC Emergency Medical Technician (EMT)

claim: National EMS Academy Dallas: course in as few as 12 weeks; page gives no clinical hours.
quote: Become an Emergency Medical Technician in 12 weeks
title: National EMS Academy Dallas

claim: Texas EMS School (Axon): online coursework (18 weeks max), a two-day in-person Skills Lab, and clinical/field experiences at first-responder organizations and major hospitals in Texas; no clinical hours or DFW site stated on page.
quote: you’ll be required to attend a two-day Skills Lab conducted by Texas EMS School.
title: Texas EMS School EMT (Axon)

claim: Collin College EMT is 9 credits: $603 in-county, $1,114-$1,143 out-of-county, plus roughly $208 lab/clinical fees (2024: $188 lab+clinical, $49 EMS testing, $67 Sterling). Read via search snippet, PDF not cached.
title: Collin College EMT program cost 2025
